description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is a defense, aerospace, and security company developing technologies for national security and mission survivability. The company is seeking an entry-level software engineer to develop EO/IR algorithms, test automation tools, and complex software for electronic warfare solutions, while collaborating with systems, hardware, and test engineers across design, development, integration, and testing.
Entry-level EO/IR software engineer developing algorithms, automated testing tools, and embedded sensor software

Responsibilities:
• Developing EO/IR tools, EO/IR algorithm development, test automation software, software tests, test automation frameworks, and testing tools for classified programs
• Duties include analyzing, designing, coding and code modification (typically in C++ and Python) of complex software designs for simple systems or subsystems or subsystems of larger systems
• Evaluate complex software designs to identify design flaws
• Prepare design documentation, in accordance with established processes
• Utilize a Linux based software development environment. Embedded targets could range from ARM through high performance x86-64 CPUs and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). You will be integrating and testing in the selected target test environments
• You may participate in external project interactions with other companies
• Desire to become a subject matter expert in EO/IR software development

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, and 0+ years of professional experience
• Experience with Object Oriented design, development practices, and implementation in C++
• Experience using scripting languages, such as Python
• Experience with Linux software development
• Willingness to perform a wide variety of related tasks
• Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret Clearance

Preferred:
• Secret Clearance (active within the last two years)
• Real-time embedded development
• Experience using Python and Modern C++
• Experience with Real-time Embedded Software Development
• Agile Development experience
• Experience using software collaboration and version control tools such as Jenkins, Jira, Confluence, BitBucket, and GitLab
• Experience with Containers including Docker, Podman or Kubernetes
